designNote: Keperluan DSKP Y2 Listening: 'understanding specific details in very simple phrases and narratives' — beralih daripada pengecaman fonem (Modul 1) kepada pemahaman naratif pendek. Kandungan bertema World of Knowledge (fakta sains ringkas & senario keselamatan).

instructions.en: Listen to the short story. Answer the question about it.

feedback.hint: Listen for the important word in the question.

items.narrativeAudioScript: Plants need water and sunlight to grow. Ali waters his plant every morning.
items.questionEn: When does Ali water his plant?

items.narrativeAudioScript: Siti found three seashells at the beach. She put them in a small blue bag.
items.questionEn: How many seashells did Siti find?

items.narrativeAudioScript: Before crossing the road, look left, look right, and look left again.
items.questionEn: What should you do before crossing the road?

items.narrativeAudioScript: The sun rises in the morning and sets in the evening. It gives us light and warmth all day.
items.questionEn: What does the sun give us?

items.narrativeAudioScript: Ravi recycles his plastic bottles. He puts them in the blue bin near his house.
items.questionEn: What colour is the bin Ravi uses?

items.narrativeAudioScript: Bees fly from flower to flower. They help plants grow by carrying pollen.
Mei Ling saves one coin every day. After ten days, she has ten coins in her jar.
items.questionEn: How many coins does Mei Ling save each day?

items.narrativeAudioScript: A caterpillar eats leaves for many days. Then it becomes a butterfly and flies away.
Always wear a helmet when riding a bicycle. It keeps your head safe if you fall.
items.questionEn: Why should you wear a helmet?

items.narrativeAudioScript: Trees give us clean air to breathe. That is why we should plant more trees.
